page.overview:
Who is Auntie Mama?

Chidra the Blue Rose, better known as , was a human smuggler from Shadycreek Run.

Auntie Mama was a human in her fifties, with a wrinkled face, rouged lips, a bit of chin hair, and gray hair. She used to wear layers of brown-and-green housecoat and floppy felt slippers ended in points, and she always had rings on her fingers.

Auntie Mama was a determined woman who had hardened over the years, becoming smart and mean, and while she showed some compassion, it ended where her own well-being began.

Chidra was born around 772 PD, growing up and eventually marrying a goliath man called Lazak Oakbender, the Dark Forge, who was so famous that was even known in the Menagerie Coast. The couple settled in the North Clover area in Shadycreek Run, and had three children together: a daughter, Brevyn, and two sons, Narath and Vik. While Lazak was a nice father for Brevyn, who loved to spend time in the forge with him, listening to his stories, the goliath was a violent man and cruel husband who beat his wife. Chidra, eventually, poisoned him, causing the goliath to fall into the forge, burning to ash. Brevyn and her brothers, Narath and Vik, were sent away.
